about: Single source of the GLM-5.3-Flash (E192) serving profiles on a (1, 4) Blackhole mesh. Rule and readers: tt/serving_profiles.py. Update with tools/serving_profiles.py (ingest a capacity probe, refresh, render-yaml); never edit the numbers in tt-model.yaml or the scripts by hand.
weights_revision_source: HF download metadata of the E192 build (~/glm53-flash-bringup/ckpt/glm53_flash_e192_fp8/.cache/huggingface/download/*.metadata): the parent commit every stage ran against
expert_set: E192: 192 of 288 routed experts per MoE layer (tt/e192_mask.json, mask of autotrust/GLM5.3-Flash-E192-DGX-Spark)

budget.status: PARTIAL: free_after_load_bytes and dsa_bytes_per_block are measured at bind time by the combo_a_kv 1-slot (pending the combo_a_kv_dense4_g4 G9 rerun) capacity probe; reserve_bytes = the 1,024 MiB serving workspace of that probe. Slot counts without a measured entry use this rule until the G9 probes (1 / 16 / 32 slots) are ingested.

evidence.free_after_load_bytes: doc/datatype_sweep/capacity/combo_a_kv_s1/capacity.json after_load (64 MiB trace region, 2 KDA slots)
evidence.dsa_bytes_per_block: doc/datatype_sweep/capacity/combo_a_kv_s1/capacity.json dsa_bytes_per_block_all_layers (11 DSA layers x 128 x (512 B fp8 latent + 64 B bf16 pool key)) = 6,336 B per token
evidence.kda_bytes_per_slot: doc/full_model/memory_budget.json kda_state_per_slot_bytes (34 layers x 16 local heads x 128 x 128 fp32)
evidence.reserve_bytes: serving workspace 1,024 MiB (stage 8 review #2: the combo_a_kv 1-slot capacity probe doc/datatype_sweep/capacity/combo_a_kv_s1 completed at --workspace-mib 1024; 832 MiB failed in the warm-up prefill, doc/datatype_sweep/capacity/combo_a_kv_s1_337920_ws832); the G9 probes use the same workspace

measured_note: slots -> {pool_blocks, max_model_len_tested, prompt_len, copy_accuracy, free_at_prefill_peak_bytes, evidence, date}; written by tools/serving_profiles.py ingest from a COMPLETED capacity probe (load, bind, warm-up, capture, longest prefill, traced decode). A measured entry wins over the budget rule for that slot count.
